info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Relationship Management API
info.description: The Corporate Relationship Management API facilitates the modification and updating of existing corporate relationships within the banking domain. This endpoint allows authorized users to make adjustments to key relationship details to ensure they reflect current agreements and interactions. Typically consumed by corporate relationship managers and banking professionals, this API enables real-time updates that enhance relationship management efficiency. By leveraging this API, organizations can maintain accurate records and foster stronger engagements with their corporate clients.

patch.description: This endpoint allows users to update the details of a specific corporate relationship identified by its unique reference ID. Make sure to provide the necessary data to modify the relationship as required.

requestBody.description: This request body allows for the partial update of a corporate relationship identified by RES-100045. The fields included in the request should correspond to the attributes of the corporate relationship that need to be modified. Please ensure that only the fields that require updating are included in the request.

200.description: The request was successful, and the resource has been updated.
